messages:
ana: Heads-up team 12:00 UTC canary tomorrow for v2.18.0. Draft release notes: https://docs.redwood/releases/v2.18.0-draft. Quiet window 11:45-13:30 UTC. Planning to post internal announce at 12:10 UTC. Please flag customer-facing items.

deploybot: /deploy canary v2.18.0 --targets=canary-small --timeout=25m
deploybot: Canary started: v2.18.0 -> canary-small (6 hosts). Watching p95, p99, 5xx, cache-hit-rate.

tim: Small behavioral change: new KV cache compaction runs asynchronously; this can briefly increase CPU on high-request paths. Add a compatibility note and suggested mitigation for heavy customers.

ana: (typo) ana: thanks tim. Added compatibility note under "Behavior changes" and a one-liner mitigation: "retry/backoff recommended for short, bursty requests".

harry: Ops note 1: Dedicated fleets will be pinned to `redwood-runtime@2026-03-21` for GA stability. Add expected unpin timeline: "target unpin 7-14 days after GA; contact SE for exceptions."

ops-oncall: Rollback criteria proposal: auto-rollback if 5xx >= 0.14% sustained for 5m OR p99 latency +30% for 10m. Manual rollback requires release owner + oncall + eng lead signoff. I will be oncall 11:30-14:00 UTC (PD_Rollout).

deploybot: Canary health @8m: p95 +4%, p99 +9%, 5xx 0.03%, cache-hit-rate stable. No auto-rollback.

support-bot: Suggested support one-liners: "Why is my runtime pinned?" -> "Pinned to ensure stability during rollout; unpin schedule communicated post-GA." "Latency changed?" -> "We observed a small tail increase; please include request-id and timeframe when filing."

ana: adding support copy to the draft release notes. Also including runbook link: https://confluence.company/ops/runbooks/v2.18-rollout.

tim: Legal flagged the telemetry blurb; they want exact wording about data retention. They can sign off within 6 hours. If legal needs more time, do we delay public announce?

ops-oncall: We can hold public announce up to 18:00 local without impacting downstream schedules. Recommend publish internal anyway and gate public announce on legal final ok.

ana: ok will post internal at 12:10 UTC and hold public announce. I'll mark the public announce as "pending legal" in the internal copy.

deploybot: Canary finished: success. Promoting to staged rollout in 10m unless ops requests a hold.

ops-oncall: Acknowledged, watching the promotion. Reminder: run the rollback dry-run in staging at 09:00 UTC and confirm permissions.

harry: done; I ran the rollback dry-run and confirmed deployer role can execute /rollback v2.18.0 -> previous. Added a note in the runbook.

ana: internal announce draft (posting to #eng-releases at 12:10 UTC):
"Internal heads-up: staged rollout of v2.18.0 begins with canary at 12:00 UTC (completed). Quiet window 11:45-13:30 UTC. Key items: runtime pinned to redwood-runtime@2026-03-21 for Dedicated fleets (unpin ~7-14d post-GA); KV cache compaction now async (compatibility note + mitigation included); telemetry wording pending legal sign-off. Rollback criteria and runbook: https://confluence.company/ops/runbooks/v2.18-rollout. Oncall: ops-oncall (PD_Rollout). Public announce: pending legal review. Questions in this thread."

ops-oncall: LGTM. I'll call for rollback immediately if thresholds hit.

support-bot: Filing suggested support macro: "v2.18.0-runtime-pin" and "v2.18.0-kv-compaction".

ana: posting internal announce now. Will queue public announce after legal sign-off. Thanks everyone :rocket:

deploybot: /announce internal "v2.18.0 staged rollout 12:00 UTC canary ok, promoting to staged; public announce pending legal" --channel=#eng-releases --when=6978901860

ana: bot queued. Closing thread after promote; continue monitoring in runbook link.
